messages:
Sam: heads-up — nightly perf shows a regression in fused-attn epilogue with paged-KV on A100s, seq=1024 bs=4. ~-9% throughput.
Talia: can you paste the exact repro config and perf output?
Sam: running the same micro-bench as before: --model flat-attn-fused --seq 1024 --bs 4 --kv_paged true --qkv_pack true. output:
```
fused_epilogue_v3: throughput=95.1 tokens/s
baseline_no_epilogue: throughput=104.5 tokens/s
metric: -9.0%
```
Sam: repro steps + pmap are in the gist I linked earlier, but this is reproducible on the nightly cluster.
Kai: interesting — last week we landed the new pack stride change that shifts QKV alignment to 64B boundaries. Could be cache-line fragmentation when paged KV causes irregular strided loads.
Anika: I ran an instrumented run with hwpc counters. L2_MISS for fused epilogue jumps ~3x when kv_paged=true and seq>=768. raw counters: L2_MISS 1.2M -> 3.6M.
Anika: small diff patch that forces 128B packing for epilogue reduces misses: quick bench shows throughput back to ~103 tokens/s on same config. Patch link: https://git.redwood/repo/epilogue/patches/128b-pack-fix (WIP).
perf-bot: nightly-regression: fused_attn_epilogue_v3: -9.4% for (seq=1024, bs=4, kv_paged=true) vs baseline_2026-03-17. See dashboard: https://perf.redwood/alerts/2802000000
Talia: if 128B packing helps, we need to evaluate impact on small-seq workloads and shared L2 pressure. Kai — can you run the micro-sweep for seq in [64,128,256,512,768,1024] with old/new pack?
Kai: will run today. Also thinking about the kernel chooser heuristic: when the difference between fused and non-fused is small but variance high, chooser sometimes oscillates and triggers the slower codepath under paging. That hysteresis needs tightening.
Sam: good call — I saw chooser flips in the logs around the time throughput dropped. Logs: `chooser: selected fused_epilogue_v3 (lat=7.8ms) -> fallback nonfused (lat=8.1ms) -> selected fused` within 30s.
Anika: proposed plan: (1) land 128B pack opt behind feature flag; (2) tighten chooser hysteresis to require 5% stable improvement over 3 samples before switching; (3) add a paged-kv qualifier so chooser prefers non-fused when kv_paged and seq>512 unless fused shows >6% lead.
Talia: sounds reasonable. We should run canary on dedicated pool and only roll to hosted after 48h. Add perf thresholds to the rollout job.
infra-bot: canary job scheduled: canary/fused-epilogue-128b-pack — runs on pool:dedicated-canary-02 for 48h.
Kai: initial micro-sweep (local A100): fused_v3 oldpack vs 128b: seq=256 bs=8 -> unchanged; seq=512 -> +1.2%; seq=768 -> +6.8%; seq=1024 -> +8.9%. I'll upload full csv.
Sam: awesome. I'll open a short PR with feature flag + docs for runtime chooser config. pinging @Talia for rollout signoff once CI is green.
Talia: please include a quick eval job that exercises paged-KV hot path (we missed that in earlier perf tests).
Anika: logged follow-up: add a L2-centric micro-benchmark to perf harness and a perf regression alert for L2_MISS spikes on fused kernels.
Sam: thanks all — immediate action items: Kai run full sweep and attach csv; Anika finish patch + add hwpc counters to perf job; Talia prepare canary gating criteria. I'll queue the PR. :thumbsup:
Anika: FYI — the 128B pack patch also simplifies epilogue prefetch stride logic so should be low-risk.
Sam: will update this thread with canary results.
